Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE detailed, production-quality native mobile app screen for Sobrita's desired-product savings goal, grounded in the attached existing Sobrita UI mockups. The user has chosen the existing visual direction and wants the feature flow refined. This is one actual proposed app screen, not a marketing ad, infographic, feature inventory, multi-screen collage, or design-options board.
Target viewport logical390x844, keep natural390:844 portrait ratio, high-resolution legible output. App content edge-to-edge only. No device bezel/notch/status bar/time/battery/browser chrome/device shadow/outer canvas.
Keep exact Sobrita visual language: warm paper #FFFDF7 and #F6EFE0, dark navy #202848 PixelifySans-like clear pixel typography, teal #0E7A72, thin square navy outlines, restrained pale-teal panels, almost no elevation. Body14–16logicalpx, labels12–13, title22, key money24–28 maximum. Buttons at least44logicalpx tall. Outer padding18px, intentional whitespace. Do not introduce generic rounded fintech cards, oversized product photos, gaudy icons or glossy gradients. Only one strong primary action.
Product image: the SAME realistic offwhite sneakers with muted teal panels and beige soles from attached mockups, small thumbnail rather than a giant hero. No brand logos. The product image is user-provided/imported example, not an automatically guaranteed retailer integration.
Spanish Mexico copy only, accurate accents. Only one active goal, no shopping checkout, automatic transfers, live price tracking, cash reward, XP, unrelated features or multiple goal tiles. All money is MXN and mock data. User verifies imported information.
Current local date anchor is9November2026 America/Mexico_City. Exact sample plan: targetMX$1,500, starting earmarked savingsMX$600, remainingMX$900. Three USER-CHOSEN future saving dates15November2026,30November2026,15December2026 inclusive =>MX$300 each. These are suggested saving dates, not assumed payroll dates or automatic debits. On9November an extraMX$150 from a prior-cycle surplus can be allocated, makingMX$750 saved=50%, remainingMX$750; the same3future planned contributions then becomeMX$250 each. Display only the state specified below. Do not contradict arithmetic or show future records as completed.
Use spacing/grouping before boxes; no cards nested inside cards. Controls and panels should fit comfortably within844logicalpx. Use the attached images as design and product references, not copy-paste whole screenshots.
Direction name: Un enlace se convierte en meta.
Screen: first step of a two-step creation flow, after link metadata is loaded. Top small Sobrita wordmark, navigation row back arrow + "Tu próxima compra". Small progress label "1 de 2 · Producto".
Show label "Enlace del producto" then square single-line URL field with link icon and "tienda.example/tenis", small right text action "Cambiar". Under it understated alternative "Crear sin enlace".
Next a horizontal product editor group: small88x88logicalpx shoe photo left, right label "Nombre de la meta", editable name field "Mis tenis", and quiet "Cambiar imagen" link. Leave room around it. Do not repeat the product name elsewhere.
Below, full-width form field label "Precio objetivo", value "MX$1,500" in teal. Two lines of helper: "Puedes ajustar el precio e incluir el envío." and muted "Precio de referencia; no se actualiza solo."
A small calm sentence with one tiny jar icon may occupy spare lower space: "Una meta para eso que quieres."
Bottom fixed full-width teal square button "Continuar", secondary muted text "El plan se define en el siguiente paso."
This screen contains ONLY the product information. No savings amount, date picker, progress percentage, goal-created success, or cash-transfer controls. Use generous whitespace, normal UI type size, and keep picture small. No marketplace logos. The reserved URL is intentionally exampledata.
